name: Bucket (A/B sticky-hash)
description: Deterministic A/B / multi-arm assignment. FNV-1a hashes the resolved key; the same key always lands in the same bucket. Used for feature flags and shadow-mode promotion. Buckets carry weights — relative split, doesn't have to sum to 100.

inputs.name: hashKey
inputs.description: What to hash — usually a stable identifier (PNR, paxId, deviceId). Same value, same bucket, every time.

params.name: buckets
params.description: Array of { name, weight } entries. Weights are relative — engine normalises by sum.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Emits the matched bucket's name as a string.
